usernames.title: Profiles
usernames.description: Instagram usernames or profile URLs. Each returns the profile plus its latest posts (Instagram shows up to 12 without login).

postUrls.title: Post or Reel URLs
postUrls.description: Optional. Direct links like https://www.instagram.com/reel/ABC123/ to get one post's numbers.

maxPostsPerProfile.title: Max posts per profile
maxPostsPerProfile.description: Instagram's public profile data holds up to 12 recent posts.

includeProfileRow.title: Add one profile summary row per account
includeProfileRow.description: Adds a row with type 'profile' (followers, post count, bio) next to the post rows.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Instagram often blocks datacenter IPs. Residential proxy works best; try the default first.

debugSaveHtml.title: Save raw profile pages (debug)
debugSaveHtml.description: Stores each fetched profile page in the key-value store, to diagnose parsing.

maxRetries.title: Retries per request
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a blocked request with a new IP.
